newsitem.title: USA: Garment Graphics to delist from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Garment Graphics to delist from Nasdaq.

text.p: Garment Graphics Inc, which is in the midst of liquidation, said Friday it has requested discontinuation of trading and delisting from Nasdaq.
The company, whose business operations have previously ceased, said it has failed to meet certain listing qualifications, including net worth and price per share.
The company also said all outside directors recently resigned from the board of directors.
Garment Graphics is liquidating assets to pay off its secured creditor, the company said.
